entries.name: FMemory::Malloc

entries.name: FName::FName(const WIDECHAR*, EFindName)
entries.notes: FName::FName(const WIDECHAR* Name, EFindName FindType): this = rcx. Writes exactly the FName at [rcx, rcx+12) -- ComparisonIndex, DisplayIndex, Number: UE 5.1 UnrealEditor builds are case preserving (WITH_CASE_PRESERVING_NAME), 12 bytes; checked against the UE testbed DLLs, whose code copies 12 bytes of the constructed FName -- with a value this model does not state (the name pool's index for the string at rdx; read with debt). Returns rcx. Reads the string at rdx and keeps no pointer it receives. Other memory this module can observe is unchanged: the name pool and its locks and allocations are Core-private state, and the constructor runs no callback into the module -- no allocator hook, ensure/log delegate (ue-core-name-pool-private).
